leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize a Node.js project with memory monitoring dependencies
Configure a test script to simulate memory-intensive operations
Implement a memory leak detection function using process.memoryUsage()
Construct a test runner that executes leak detection at intervals
Integrate console logging to display real-time memory consumption data
Manipulate object creation patterns to intentionally trigger memory leaks
Apply cleanup mechanisms to prevent memory accumulation in test scenarios
lessonTitle: Build memory leak detection test run
